claim.polarity: every effect on a required surface in the scope took a mediated route

This mediation policy is assumed; holding the credential alone would not show it

the route field of rp-http-ledger is authoritative; route rp-http-capability is recorded only for requests executed after verifying a capability bound to exactly one gateway record
each effect_ref identifies exactly one execution and is never reused, and the route evidence and mediation policies apply throughout the claim interval
